people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: Behold, I send out the promise of my Father on you. But wait in the city of Jerusalem until you are clothed with power from on high.”
translations.bsb: And behold, I am sending the promise of My Father upon you. But remain in the city until you have been clothed with power from on high.”
translations.kjv: And, behold, I send the promise of my Father upon you: but tarry ye in the city of Jerusalem, until ye be endued with power from on high.
translations.asv: And behold, I send forth the promise of my Father upon you: but tarry ye in the city, until ye be clothed with power from on high.
